summary: Boqii Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated August 13, 2026, responding to unusual trading activity in its Class A ordinary shares on NYSE American on August 12, 2026. Issued under Section 401(d) of the NYSE American Company Guide as a no-news statement, the company confirmed after internal review that no material developments exist beyond previously disclosed information. The filing is a routine response to market volatility with no transaction terms, advisors, or structural details. No special-situation event is identified; the release merely addresses perceived market action and directs investors to official disclosures. What to watch: potential for subsequent announcements if trading volatility persists, though no operational or strategic changes are indicated.
